text:
**Higher churn in South Korea lacks a statistically reliable driver.**  

- Overall churn: 29.3 % (n = 215) vs 24.8 % elsewhere; gap +4.5 pts (p = 0.129) – not significant.  
- **Significant finding:** Device & app support tickets make up 20 % of all tickets in South Korea versus 12 % elsewhere (p = 0.001).  
- No other tested variables reached the p < 0.01 threshold; with 15 comparisons, any p < 0.05 could be a false positive.  

**Suggested actions**  
1. Investigate the nature of the device/app issues (e.g., compatibility, performance) to see if they correlate with individual churn events.  
2. Run a focused A/B test improving app stability or device support for Korean users and monitor churn response.
